```{r setup}
#| echo: false

# Load dashboardr (includes dplyr, highcharter as dependencies)
library(dashboardr)

# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

# Bundle loader — reads the RDS bundle once, then extracts datasets by key
.load_bundle <- function(bundle_file, key) {
  if (!exists('.dashboardr_bundle_cache', inherits = FALSE))
    .dashboardr_bundle_cache <<- list()
  if (is.null(.dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]]))
    .dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]] <<- readRDS(bundle_file)
  if (!(key %in% names(.dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]])))
    stop("Bundle key '", key, "' not found in ", bundle_file, call. = FALSE)
  .dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]][[key]]
}

# Load multiple datasets

# Load wp2
wp2 <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'wp2_151obs.rds')
cat('wp2 loaded:', nrow(wp2), 'rows,', ncol(wp2), 'columns\n')

# Load domains_long
domains_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'domains_long_330obs.rds')
cat('domains_long loaded:', nrow(domains_long), 'rows,', ncol(domains_long), 'columns\n')

# Load problems_long
problems_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'problems_long_236obs.rds')
cat('problems_long loaded:', nrow(problems_long), 'rows,', ncol(problems_long), 'columns\n')

# Load outcomes_long
outcomes_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'outcomes_long_235obs.rds')
cat('outcomes_long loaded:', nrow(outcomes_long), 'rows,', ncol(outcomes_long), 'columns\n')

# Load problems_report
problems_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'problems_report_6obs.rds')
cat('problems_report loaded:', nrow(problems_report), 'rows,', ncol(problems_report), 'columns\n')

# Load outcomes_report
outcomes_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'outcomes_report_7obs.rds')
cat('outcomes_report loaded:', nrow(outcomes_report), 'rows,', ncol(outcomes_report), 'columns\n')

# Load runtime_report
runtime_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'runtime_report_4obs.rds')
cat('runtime_report loaded:', nrow(runtime_report), 'rows,', ncol(runtime_report), 'columns\n')

```

## Initiators, scope and runtime


The **public sector** is best represented: 60% of interventions come from government agencies, municipalities, schools, libraries and similar institutions. 25% emerged from a **public-private collaboration**, such as internet safety programmes by ministries and internet providers. **Private sector** actors, such as health care providers, commercial training centres or tech companies, initiate 15% of the interventions.

The majority of interventions is intended for the **national** level (46%), often combined with local implementation. **Regional** (27%) and **online** interventions (24%) are common as well.

Only 9% of interventions specified an explicit start and end date. Most interventions (58%) did not specify a runtime, even though information and materials remain available online; 31% are recurring or ongoing interventions, and 1% explicitly state that the intervention has been discontinued.


::: {.panel-tabset}

### {{< iconify ph buildings-fill >}} Initiators


```{r org-initiator}
# Initiators
result <- viz_bar(
  data = wp2 %>% tidyr::drop_na(initiator_lab),
  title = "Initiators",
  horizontal = TRUE,
  bar_type = "percent",
  sort_by_value = TRUE,
  color_palette = "#3D7271",
  x_label = "",
  y_label = "% of interventions",
  x_var = "initiator_lab"
)

# Set chart height
if (inherits(result, 'highchart')) {
  result <- highcharter::hc_size(result, height = 320)
}

# Force container height with explicit wrapper
result <- htmltools::div(
  style = 'height: 320px !important; min-height: 320px !important; width: 100%; overflow: visible;',
  result
)

result
```

### {{< iconify ph calendar-fill >}} Runtime


```{r org-runtime}
# Runtime of the interventions (% of interventions)
result <- viz_bar(
  data = runtime_report,
  title = "Runtime of the interventions (% of interventions)",
  horizontal = TRUE,
  x_var = "category",
  y_var = "pct",
  x_order = c("No runtime specified", "Recurring or ongoing", "Explicit start and end date", "Explicitly discontinued"),
  color_palette = "#3D7271",
  x_label = "",
  y_label = "% of interventions",
  tooltip_suffix = "%"
)

# Set chart height
if (inherits(result, 'highchart')) {
  result <- highcharter::hc_size(result, height = 340)
}

# Force container height with explicit wrapper
result <- htmltools::div(
  style = 'height: 340px !important; min-height: 340px !important; width: 100%; overflow: visible;',
  result
)

result
```
